escena_base: the Barkademy classroom (chalkboard reading 'BARKADEMY', dog cubbies, paw prints on the wall)
premisa: Pepe (profe/cuidador niño) intenta enseñar a dar la pata. Corre el gag 'Give me the paw!' y cada perro lo subvierte. Comedia + ternura. Cierra en montaña de perros con callback de Tank.
notas_punch: Cold-open con Tank (planta el callback). Cortar todo lo que no sea setup o remate. Pausa de ~0.5s antes de cada remate, luego corte rápido a la reacción. Un SFX justo en la palabra del chiste. Subtítulos bold palabra-por-palabra, resaltando la palabra clave (85% ve en mudo). Caras MUY exageradas.

panels.accion: COLD OPEN, extreme close-up: tiny Tank trembling with rage, growling at the camera; Pepe's hand patiently open in frame
panels.sfx: tiny angry growl + comedic tension sting
panels.comedia: Hook de conflicto en 2s. Planta el callback de Tank para el final.

panels.accion: Rex limps over dragging one paw like a wounded soldier, milking it; held beat on his tragic face before the line

dialogo.dice: I am ALWAYS in interior pain.

panels.comedia: Primer subversión: drama exagerado. Regla de tres, beat 1.

panels.accion: SirWheeze stays flat on the floor and just slides his paw across the ground without lifting it, eyes barely open
panels.comedia: Mínimo esfuerzo, deadpan. Regla de tres, beat 2 (refuerza el patrón).

panels.accion: Bear calmly places the paw PERFECTLY, then looks at Pepe like a proud mentor grading his student
panels.sfx: RECORD SCRATCH on the twist (the dog is teaching the teacher)
panels.comedia: EL GIRO (regla de tres, beat 3 que rompe el patrón): Bear no obedece, EVALÚA a Pepe.

panels.accion: Bruno stares at Pepe's empty open hand, tilts head; then bursts forward and licks Pepe's whole face while Pepe laughs

dialogo.dice: What are we even playing? ...OH! I know!

panels.sfx: happy boing + slobbery lick + Pepe laughing
panels.comedia: Lógica de bobo feliz → ternura (lamida + risa). Pico emocional antes del clímax.

panels.accion: Africa: 'I know what you REALLY want' — tackles Pepe VERY playfully, all dogs pile on, happy mountain of dogs, Pepe laughing underneath; Tank surfaces on top, smug

dialogo.dice: The paw? I know what you REALLY want.
Told you. Got you AND your paw.

panels.sfx: big playful whoosh + dog pile + final comedic sting on Tank's line
panels.comedia: Clímax de ternura + CALLBACK de Tank que cierra el chiste (paga el cold-open). Cortar inmediatamente después.

panels_eliminados.linea: Paw! Sir yes sir. ...You guys are morons.
panels_eliminados.razon: Se sacó del corte para no tener DOS perros 'perfectos' seguidos (Bear ya hace ese beat). Guardado como escena para otro capítulo.

caption: Day one at Barkademy: teaching the paw. Results... varied. 🐾
